verse.verse_1: By those who pull out, drowning.
verse.verse_5: And by those who arrange affairs.
verse.verse_6: On the Day the Rajifah shakes,
verse.verse_10: They say: "Shall we indeed be brought back from Al-Hafirah"
verse.verse_12: They say: "It would in that case, be a return with loss!"
verse.verse_13: But it will be only a single Zajrah.
verse.verse_14: When behold, they are at As-Sahirah.
verse.verse_15: Has there come to you the story of Musa
verse.verse_16: When his Lord called him in the holy valley of Tuwa,
verse.verse_17: Go to Fir`awn; verily, he has transgressed all bounds.
verse.verse_18: And say to him: "Would you purify yourself"
verse.verse_19: "And that I guide you to your Lord, so you should fear Him"
verse.verse_20: Then he showed him the great sign.
verse.verse_23: So he gathered and called out,
verse.verse_24: Saying: "I am your lord, most high."
verse.verse_25: So Allah seized him with punishing example for the Hereafter and the first (life).
verse.verse_26: In this is a lesson for whoever fears.
verse.verse_27: Are you more difficult to create or is the heaven that He constructed
verse.verse_28: He raised its hei- ght, and has perfected it.
verse.verse_29: Its night He covers and He brings out its forenoon.
verse.verse_30: And after that He spread the earth,
verse.verse_31: And brought forth therefrom its water and its pasture.
verse.verse_32: And the mountains He has fixed firmly,
verse.verse_33: As provision and benefit for you and your cattle.
verse.verse_34: But when there comes the Greatest Catastrophe
verse.verse_35: The Day when man shall remember what he strove for.
verse.verse_36: And Hell shall be made apparent for whoever sees.
verse.verse_38: And preferred the life of this world,
verse.verse_39: Verily, his abode will be the Hell;
verse.verse_40: But as for him who feared standing before his Lord, and forbade himself from desire.
verse.verse_41: Verily, Paradise will be his abode.
verse.verse_42: They ask you about the Hour when will be its appointed time
verse.verse_43: What do you have to mention of it.
verse.verse_44: To your Lord it is limited.
verse.verse_45: You are only a warner for those who fear it,
verse.verse_46: The Day they see it (it will be) as if they had not tarried (in this world) except an (`Ashiyyah) afternoon or its (Duha) morning.
